usageNotes: Use to reboot or gracefully shut down a Proxmox VE node. The caller must hold Sys.PowerMgmt on /nodes/{node}; API tokens work if that privilege is granted. The call returns null synchronously — the node begins the command immediately, so any running VMs or containers should be stopped or migrated first to avoid data loss.

examples.summary: Reboot a node after a kernel update

tips: Shut down or live-migrate all VMs and containers before issuing 'shutdown' to prevent ungraceful guest termination.
Use GET /nodes/{node}/status first to confirm the node is online and not already in a degraded state.
In a cluster, ensure quorum will be maintained after the node goes offline — avoid rebooting more than (N-1)/2 nodes simultaneously.
There is no UPID returned; poll GET /nodes/{node}/status or watch cluster logs to confirm the node comes back online after a reboot.
